verdict.rationale: Homebrew is itself an official CLI (`brew`), with full manpage documentation. It has automation-friendly behaviour: `NONINTERACTIVE=1` installs, `--yes` for admin scripts, `brew info --json` machine-readable output, and the `brew bundle check || brew bundle install` idempotent scripting pattern for CI. Community users corroborate daily hands-on CLI use. Missing for 10: explicit AI/agent-oriented CLI guidance or machine-readable docs (llms.txt returns 404).
